endpoints.description: Positioning and sentiment on stock perps — which side of TSLA, NVDA or gold is crowded right now, 24/7. Funding rates and open interest on equities exist nowhere else. Answers "most crowded equity trade", "are TSLA longs paying", "where is open interest concentrated". Per market: annualized funding, crowding label, OI in USD, OI share, volume/OI turnover, premium vs oracle. From Hyperliquid HIP-3 markets. Deterministic, no LLM.
Institutional-grade, decision-ready crypto market brief — spot, derivatives (funding, options skew, DVOL), on-chain flows, regional premiums and macro-event odds. For trading and advisor agents.

Deterministic, data-only crypto snapshot: BTC/ETH price, 24h change, market cap, BTC dominance, total market cap, and Fear & Greed sentiment. No LLM, no narrative — a $0.25 preview tier for agents with small per-call spend caps. Includes an upsell pointer to the $0.50 /api/research-brief for regime calls, catalysts, derivatives (funding/DVOL/skew), on-chain flows and macro-event odds.

metadata.description: Real-time cryptocurrency intelligence API. Pay-per-query via x402 micropayments on Base.

endpoints.description: Crypto market context for macro and multi-asset agents — BTC, ETH and majors with the Fear and Greed read and the risk-on/risk-off signal that ties crypto to broader macro flows.
Real-time directional sentiment for any forex pair or gold — retail crowd positioning, COT institutional alignment, and a clear contrarian bias call. Built for FX trading and advisor agents.

metadata.description: Real-time macro intelligence API for forex and CFD traders, plus deterministic market primitives. 14 endpoints: session briefs, economic events, COT positioning, commodities, equities, economic calendar, crypto, EIA inventory, directional sentiment, intermarket synthesis, rate differentials and macro regime classification (LLM-synthesized from FRED, CFTC, Alpha Vantage, EIA, CoinGecko and Tavily) — plus two zero-LLM, fully deterministic primitives at $0.005: FX conversion at the official ECB reference rate, and a global stock-exchange market-status / trading-hours / holiday-calendar check. Pay-per-query via x402 micropayments on Base and Solana.

endpoints.description: Crypto market tick — BTC, ETH, SOL live price + 24h change, Fear & Greed index, and a deterministic regime verdict (RISK_ON / DRIFT_UP / CHOP / DRIFT_DOWN / RISK_OFF) in ONE $0.05 call. Built for agent loops that need a cheap market pulse every cycle; escalate to /api/scan/crypto ($2) for the institutional deep scan with technicals, derivatives and a directional call. 60s freshness, no LLM in the path.

metadata.description: Cross-asset trading intelligence engine. Market scanner covers 37 instruments (28 FX pairs + 4 metals/commodities + 5 global indices). FX-only scanner for 28 pairs. Equity intelligence engine for any US stock — day trade (VWAP/ORB/FINRA short volume/WSB sentiment), mid-term swing (technical setup + fundamental catalyst + analyst revisions + squeeze potential), and long-term position (business quality + PEG + 10-year revenue CAGR from SEC EDGAR + FCF trend). Equity screener finds the best stock to buy right now. Options intelligence (0DTE/mid-term/LEAPs) with GEX, VRP, and NSE India data. Sports picks for 35+ sports. Polymarket prediction market scanner. Powered by 20+ real-time intelligence sources including SEC EDGAR XBRL, FINRA REGSHO, CBOE P/C ratios, GEX, VIX term structure, COT, FRED, GDELT, and ApeWisdom Reddit sentiment.
